inputs.original_text: They're clearly trying to ram through changes to Cyprus’ surveillance legislation to strip out judicial oversight entirely, all so the hidden elites and institutions can ramp up spying without any real checks in place. The lawyers started flagging this on Monday, and the amended bill is lined up for a vote in the House plenum on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides brought it up right after a recent closed session, which just shows how they're coordinating these moves behind closed doors to avoid any pushback. It's all coordinated manipulation to expand control over everyone while pretending it's just routine legislation.
inputs.modified_text: They're pushing hard to overhaul Cyprus’ surveillance legislation and wipe out all judicial oversight, which lets the hidden elites and institutions crank up unchecked spying on the population. Lawyers flagged the moves on Monday, with the amended bill now queued for a House plenum vote on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides raised it straight after a recent closed session, confirming the coordination happening behind doors to dodge any real resistance. This is straight-up coordinated manipulation to tighten elite control while pretending it's just routine lawmaking.
